subject: A tall rectangular arcade cabinet roughly twice as tall as it is wide and about half as deep as it is wide, standing on a flat black base plinth, with a dark blue body, a black control panel angled forward at waist height holding a red joystick ball on the left and six yellow buttons on the right, a black bezel-framed screen showing a solid magenta display set high on the front face, a marquee panel at the very top with a yellow backlit sign, red side panels running the full height, a black back panel with a rectangular vent grille, and a flat black top face.

views.front: Show the front face with the marquee sign at top, the magenta screen in its black bezel, the control panel with joystick and buttons, and the black base plinth at the bottom; the cabinet's full width and height must fill the frame with a small even margin on all sides and touch no edge; no shadow, no ground, no reflection.
views.side: Show the left side elevation as a flat red panel of the full cabinet height and depth, with the black base plinth at the bottom and the angled control panel edge protruding at waist height; the height must exactly match the front view and the depth must fill the frame with the same small even margin; the screen, marquee and buttons must NOT appear; no shadow, no ground, no reflection.
views.back: Show the back elevation as a dark blue panel of the same width as the front view, with the black rectangular vent grille in the lower half and the black base plinth at the bottom; the marquee, screen, joystick and buttons must NOT appear; the width and height must exactly match the front view; no shadow, no ground, no reflection.
views.top: Show the top face looking straight down: a flat black rectangle whose width exactly matches the front view and whose depth exactly matches the side view, with the yellow marquee edge visible along the front edge; the screen, buttons and vent grille must NOT appear; no shadow, no ground, no reflection.
